title: AURA-Eval: Evaluation Framework for Acting Under Risk Awareness in LLM Agent Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2609.06783v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents operate in workflows where unsafe actions can have real consequences. Existing safety evaluations often reduce behavior to a single score, obscuring risk recognition, pre-action detection, and safe task completion when a safe solution exists. We introduce AURA-Eval, a framework combining controlled augmentation with granular diagnosis of behavior in tool-use trajectories. Its pipeline identifies safety-critical decision points, generates controlled variations, and constructs counterparts differing in whether a request has a safe fulfillment path. Using 157 sourced trajectories, we generate 1,249 evaluation items and evaluate 20 frontier and open-weight models. We developed rubrics to classify risk detection, action strategy, and scenario-specific action safety. translated_title: AURA-Eval：LLM智能体轨迹中风险感知行为评估框架
translated_abstract: LLM智能体在工作流程中运行，不安全的行为可能产生真实后果。现有的安全评估通常将行为简化为单一分数，掩盖了风险识别、行动前检测以及在存在安全解决方案时安全完成任务的能力。我们提出了AURA-Eval，这是一个将受控增强与工具使用轨迹中行为细粒度诊断相结合的框架。其流程可识别安全关键的决策点，生成受控变体，并构建在请求是否存在安全实现路径方面有所不同的对应项。基于157条来源轨迹，我们生成了1,249个评估项目，并评估了20个前沿和开源权重模型。我们开发了评分标准来分类风险检测、行动策略和特定场景下的行动安全性。我们的结果表明，当不存在安全实现路径时，LLM智能体更频繁地表现出不安全行为。在这些情况下，前沿专有模型更经常……
tldr: 本文提出AURA-Eval框架，通过受控增强与细粒度诊断评估LLM智能体在工具使用轨迹中的风险识别与安全行为，发现当不存在安全实现路径时智能体更容易做出不安全行为。
en_tdlr: AURA-Eval is an evaluation framework combining controlled augmentation with granular diagnosis to assess risk awareness and safe behavior in LLM agent tool-use trajectories, revealing that agents engage in unsafe behavior more often when no safe fulfillment path exists.
